sections.title: Primary Air Handling Units (AHU-1 to AHU-8) — Indoor Breeding Buildings C1-C4 & D1-D4

items.description: Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of double-skin Primary Air Handling Unit, draw-through type, complete with DX cooling coil, supply & return/exhaust fan sections (EC/plug fan with VFD), mixing box, pre-filter G4 + fine filter F9 (1220 x 450 modules) on fresh air, G4 on return, 1" aluminium washable filters (4 nos), motorised dampers on fresh air/return/exhaust, access doors, drain pan & vibration isolators. Supply air 12,350 m3/hr, exhaust air 12,350 m3/hr, fresh air 0-2,500 m3/hr, ESP 500 Pa supply / 500 Pa return, cooling coil 112.5 kW (DX, R-134a or equivalent, evap. -10 deg C), room design 5 deg C min / 25 deg C max +/- 1 deg C. Tags AHU-1 to AHU-8. Ref: HVAC-10, 11, 12.

Air-cooled Condensing Unit Rack for AHU (CUR-1 to CUR-8): 3 nos semi-hermetic reciprocating compressors per rack, rack cooling capacity 115 kW, R-134a or equivalent, high ambient 46 deg C, evap. -10 deg C, EER 2.2, complete with air-cooled condenser, oil separator, liquid receiver, suction accumulator, oil vessel, filter drier, sight glass, solenoid valve, HP/LP switches, crankcase heaters, electronic expansion valve & isolation valves. Located on machine roof deck. Ref: HVAC-10, 11, 12.
Compressor rack controller / control panel (COMPRESSOR CONTROLLER 1200x400) for each CUR rack, with capacity staging, alarms & interface to AHU. Ref: HVAC-10.

Refrigerant piping between AHU DX coil and condensing rack: 2-1/8" suction line (insulated, 19 mm closed-cell) & 1-1/8" liquid line, refrigeration grade copper, brazed, with supports, pressure test & vacuum. Estimated 20 m run per AHU. Ref: HVAC-10.
Refrigerant R-134a (or equivalent) first charge for AHU/CUR circuits.

Temperature & humidity (hygrometry) sensors / controllers per building & zone (cage area, corridors, service rooms) as per room schedule on HVAC-11, incl. duct temperature sensors & wiring to AHU controller.

sections.title: Fresh Air Handling Units (FAHU-1 to FAHU-4)

items.description: Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of Fresh Air Handling Unit, double-skin, with DX cooling coil, G4 + F9 filtration, supply & exhaust fans, energy recovery (as applicable), 3,000 m3/hr supply / 3,000 m3/hr exhaust, fresh air 0-3,000 m3/hr, ESP 500 Pa, cooling coil 4 x 16 kW, unit cooling capacity 18.59 kW, R-134a or equivalent, 50 deg C ambient, 12.5 deg C evap., EER 1.5. Ref: HVAC-12.

Air-cooled condenser / condensing unit for FAHU (CON-1-CD-AHU01 to CON-1-CD-AHU04) with compressor, complete with all standard accessories (receiver, drier, sight glass, solenoid valve, HP/LP, crankcase heater). Ref: HVAC-12.
FAHU compressor controller panel (800x300), FAHU COMPRESSOR-01 to 04. Ref: HVAC-10.
Refrigerant piping FAHU coil to condenser (suction & liquid, insulated), estimated 15 m per unit, incl. refrigerant charge.

sections.title: Secondary Cooling Units — Evaporators & Condensing Units (FRZ-1 to FRZ-32 / KCU-1 to KCU-8)

items.description: Ceiling-suspended dual-discharge evaporator unit (Carrier DUO40 344C 4PH or approved equivalent), cooling capacity 15 kW nominal (12.56 kW duty), 4 x 0.75 kW fans, evap. -5 deg C, with drain pan & drain connection, suspended from existing purlins on 12 mm threaded rods. 4 nos per breeding hall. Tags FRZ-1 to FRZ-32. Ref: HVAC-01A, 01B, 12.

Air-cooled Condensing Unit KCU (KCU-1 to KCU-8), capacity 35 kW as per equipment schedule, 8 nos compressors, R-134a or equivalent, high ambient, complete with receiver, drier, sight glass, solenoid valve, HP/LP, crankcase heater, accumulator. Quantity subject to confirmation — refer clarification note 4 below. Ref: HVAC-10, 12.
KCU controller panel (800x300), KCU-01 to KCU-08. Ref: HVAC-10.
Refrigerant suction line 1-3/8" copper, insulated 19 mm closed-cell with UV-resistant cladding for exposed runs, from KCU to evaporators. Estimated. Ref: HVAC-01A.
Refrigerant liquid line 3/4" copper with insulation, from KCU to evaporators. Estimated. Ref: HVAC-01A.
Refrigerant R-134a (or equivalent) charge for KCU/FRZ circuits.
Condensate drain piping uPVC 32 mm / 50 mm with insulation from evaporators to nearest drain, incl. traps & fittings ('AC DRAIN DOWN TYPICAL'). Estimated.

sections.title: GI Ductwork — Supply, Return, Fresh Air & Exhaust

items.description: Galvanised steel rectangular ductwork (SMACNA / DW144 gauges) for AHU supply & return air distribution in breeding halls: mains 1000x500 (SAD), 1400x500 (RAD), 850x450, 600x400, 500x350 & branches 250x200, complete with fittings, elbows with turning vanes, reducers, take-offs, hangers & supports from existing purlins/trusses. Quantity estimated from layouts HVAC-02 to 05 (8 halls, 2 supply + 2 return mains per hall, approx. 44 supply & 44 return branch drops per hall). To be verified against shop drawings.

GI rectangular ductwork 1000x500 for AHU fresh air intake, exhaust discharge, duct offsets & risers on mezzanine/machine room level incl. guide vanes (HVAC-10), and FAHU supply/exhaust ductwork. Estimated.

GI rectangular exhaust ductwork EAD 150x100 (10 & 25 L/s), 200x150 (45 L/s), 250x200 (90 L/s), 300x200 (125 L/s) for service rooms (changing room, garbage, transfer, storage, water/electrical PR, lavatory etc.) in 8 halls, office, sanitization & water tank buildings. Estimated. Ref: HVAC-02 to 08.
GI spiral round ducting dia 125, 150, 200, 250, 300 & 315 mm (SFAD/RFAD supply & return for ducted units, extract fan ducts) incl. fittings & supports. Estimated.
Flexible insulated aluminium duct dia 100, 200 & 250 mm (max 1.5 m per connection) with clamps.

Thermal insulation to supply air & fresh air ductwork: 25 mm (min.) fibreglass / closed-cell insulation, density as per spec, with aluminium foil facing, vapour sealed; aluminium cladding for external / roof-exposed runs.
Acoustic lining 25 mm to first 3 m of supply & return duct at each AHU (alternative to attenuators where not shown).
Duct sealant, gaskets, flanges, cleats, supports, threaded rods, anchor bolts, canvas connections & all consumables.
Ceiling supply air square grille / diffuser (aluminium, powder coated) with opposed blade damper, on 250x200 branch ducts. Approx. 44 nos per hall x 8. Ref: HVAC-01A, 02 to 05.
Ceiling return air square grille (aluminium, powder coated) with OBD on 250x200 return branches. Approx. 44 nos per hall x 8.
Return air grille 1000x400 (aluminium) at sound attenuator / return main. 2 nos per hall.
Sound attenuator 900(L) x 1000(W) x 400(H) mm, rectangular splitter type, on 1000x500 supply/return mains. 2 nos per hall. Ref: HVAC-02 to 05.
Sound attenuator 900(L) x 550(W) x 400(H) mm on secondary supply mains. 2 nos per hall.
Volume control damper (galvanised, opposed blade, manual quadrant) for main ducts: 1000x500, 1400x500, 850x450, 600x400, 500x350 (avg 10 nos per hall).
Volume control damper 250x200 at each supply & return branch.
Motorised damper (with actuator) on AHU fresh air, return & exhaust connections (3 per AHU) and FAHU fresh air/exhaust (2 per FAHU).
Fire damper, 1.5 hr rated, with fusible link & access door, at plant/machine room wall & floor penetrations (2 per AHU + 1 per FAHU).
Exhaust air grille / disc valve 150 mm dia (EAG 01) and exhaust diffusers EAD 01 / EAD 02 in service rooms. Estimated.
Supply / return flexible-duct air diffusers SFAD 01/02 & RFAD 01/02/03 (round neck, aluminium) for ducted units. Estimated.
Self-balanced (non-return) grilles / pressure relief grilles as per legend, estimated.
Access doors 300x300 / 450x450 in ductwork at dampers, attenuators & coils.
Flexible canvas connections at all AHU / FAHU / fan inlet & outlet.
Test holes, thermometer wells, balancing & TAB (testing, adjusting & balancing) report for all AHU systems.
Inline exhaust fan 470 m3/hr, 200 W, 240V/1ph/50Hz (EF-1, EF-4, EF-5, EF-8) with backdraught damper, speed controller & mounting. Ref: HVAC-12.
Inline exhaust fan 420 m3/hr, 200 W, 240V/1ph/50Hz (EF-2, EF-3, EF-6, EF-7). Ref: HVAC-12.
Inline exhaust fan 180 m3/hr, 100 W, 240V/1ph (EF-9 — sanitization building). Ref: HVAC-06, 12.
Inline exhaust fan 55 m3/hr, 0.10 kW (EF-10 — office building & water tank building). Ref: HVAC-07, 08.
Wall / ceiling extract fan 150 mm dia with E.A.G. for lavatories & garbage rooms (2 per hall). Ref: HVAC-02 to 05.
Axial cabinet fan as per legend / fresh-air relief (estimated).
MCC / control panels for AHU & FAHU (MCC-01-AB to MCC-04-AB 1000x250, MCC-FAHU-AB, MCC-DUAL panels) incl. VFDs, starters, interlocks & BMS interface. Ref: HVAC-10.
Power & control cabling from MCC to AHU, CUR racks, FAHU, KCU, evaporators & fans, incl. 75x75 cable trunking at high level, earthing & terminations. Estimated.
Installation, rigging & positioning of AHUs and condensing racks on machine roof deck (incl. crane hire).
Installation & commissioning of FAHU with condensers.
Installation & commissioning of secondary cooling units (KCU + 4 evaporators per hall), incl. pressure test, vacuum & charging.
Site supervision, scaffolding & access equipment for ductwork, insulation & accessories installation across all halls & buildings.
Testing, adjusting & balancing, commissioning, O&M manuals, as-built drawings & training.
Freight, transport, unloading & storage at Rawdat Al Faras site.

notes: This is a BUDGETARY quotation issued at the client's request for planning purposes. Prices are indicative within +/- 15% and are subject to final confirmation from our manufacturers. A firm quotation will be issued within 10 working days of receipt of the clarifications at note 4.
Equipment quantities (AHU, CUR, FAHU, KCU, FRZ, EF, VRV & FCU) are taken from the consultant's Equipment Schedule GETC-MECC-DD-HVAC-12 Rev.01.

Ductwork areas, grille and damper counts, refrigerant pipe lengths and charges are indicative, assessed from the 1:110 layout drawings, and will be re-measured against approved shop drawings at firm pricing. Final contract value will be adjusted at the unit rates stated.

Clarification required: KCU condensing unit capacity is shown as 25 kW on the layouts and 35 kW in the equipment schedule; the schedule also notes 'QTY should be 16 UNITS' against 8 nos. This quotation is based on 8 nos at 35 kW. Additional units will be charged at the unit rate in item C.2.
Section G (VRV / FCU for service rooms, offices & corridors) is offered as a separate option and is excluded from the Grand Total.
Included: supply, delivery to site, installation, testing, adjusting, balancing and commissioning as itemised above; 12 months warranty from commissioning on equipment against manufacturing defects.

Excluded: civil, builder's work, openings and making good; electrical mains supply and distribution up to our MCC panels; BMS/SCADA integration beyond volt-free contacts; cranage beyond that stated; site accommodation and utilities; any duties or levies introduced after the quotation date; any item not expressly stated.

Payment terms: 40% advance with LPO; 40% against delivery of major equipment to site; 20% on completion of commissioning. Delivery: 14-16 weeks for AHUs and condensing racks from receipt of approved technical submittal and advance; balance items to suit site programme.
Prices are in Qatari Riyals, delivered to site at Rawdat Al Faras. Validity 15 days from the date above.
